# SafeHome Pest Control

> Local pest control company serving homes, shops and offices in Your City, India. Free inspection, fixed quotes, written termite warranty. Staff speak English, Hindi and Marathi.

## Services
- Cockroach control: gel baiting and spray treatment
- Termite control: pre- and post-construction, with written warranty
- Bed bug treatment: mattresses, beds, furniture
- Mosquito and fly control: fogging and larvicide
- Rodent control: trapping, baiting, sealing entry points
- Ant and spider control

## Key facts
- Inspection: free, with a fixed quote before work starts
- Typical treatment time: 1 to 3 hours
- Products: low-odour, approved by the Central Insecticides Board (CIB&RC)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98000 00000
- Address: Shop No. 1, Main Road, Your City
